lines.text: The root is Tract! Contract, subtract.
Did you know? Tract is Latin for pull.
Quick quiz! Which means under plus pull?

words.ex: She signed a two-year contract with the company.
Subtract the ten percent discount from the total price on the invoice.

publish.title: Tract root: contract and subtract
publish.value: Tract comes from Latin "trahere" (to pull, to drag). Words: contract and subtract. contract = con + tract; subtract = sub + tract.
